text:
elaine (partnerships): Hey team — sending over the SI onboarding asset pack from GridWave. Need quick checks on logo variants, lockups, and a short approved customer quote. Timeline: launch draft by EOD Friday. Figma: https://figma.com/file/gridwave/redwood-partner-pack :wave:

sam (design): Got it. downloading files now. do they have full-color, mono, and reversed? also need vector (svg/pdf) for marketplace thumbnails. :mag:

elaine (partnerships): Yes — they included master.ai and pngs. attached a flattened zip in the folder. I pulled primary logos into Figma frame "GW-logos-2025".

assetbot (system): Uploaded: GridWave-asset-pack-v2.zip to /partnerships/gridwave/1799990000 — sha256: d3b07384d113edec49eaa6238ad5ff00.

sam (design): Quick notes: 1) their primary logo has tight clearspace around the mark — recommend 12px min at 72dpi (or 8% of mark width) for thumbnails. 2) reversed white version fails contrast against our dark navy hero (#0B2340) for small sizes. Suggest using white with 1px dark stroke for thumbnails. 3) need alt text for each image.

chris (marketing): For the quote: customer gave this line — "Redwood cut our inference latency in half and simplified our deployment." raj, legal OK? we should shorten for hero tile. maybe: "Halved inference latency and simplified deployment."

raj (legal): I need to confirm GridWave granted co-marketing rights for third-party marketplace listings. Does their contract include logo use for marketplace tiles and case studies? If so, we need a trademark attribution line: "GridWave is a trademark of GridWave, Inc." Also confirm permission to edit the quote.

elaine (partnerships): Contract says "marketing materials including marketplace listings and collateral" — I'll attach clause 4.2. Note: they asked for logo to always be accompanied by the Redwood lockup when used in joint assets.

sam (design): Figma comments added: 1) export SVGs with 'preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"' 2) include a 48px min width for marketplace tile logos. 3) color hexes: primary gridwave blue #0066CC, accent teal #00B7A8 — contrast vs white is fine. code snippet for export settings:

```
svg {
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  preserveAspectRatio: 'xMidYMid meet'
}
exportSettings: {format: 'svg', outlineText: true}
```

chris (marketing): Approved shortened quote above. Also need a 15-word case blurb for marketplace tile — draft: "GridWave and Redwood reduced latency and made serving simple across cloud and on-prem." Thoughts?

raj (legal): Quote edit is OK. Add a small rights line under the case PDF: "Used with permission. GridWave and Redwood names are used under license." That should cover it.

sam (design): Alt text suggestions added inline in Figma comments. Example: "GridWave + Redwood architecture diagram showing inference routed from cloud to on-prem using Redwood Dedicated." Keep them under 125 chars for accessibility.

elaine (partnerships): Great — can we get final assets by Thursday noon so product can wire into marketplace page? If everyone thumbs up, I'll send final checklist to GridWave. :thumbsup:

chris (marketing): Thumbs up from me. I'll draft the 15-word blurb and a 1-sentence marketing line for the listings.

raj (legal): Thumbs up. I'll add the trademark and rights lines to the case PDF and sign off.

sam (design): I'll export SVG/PNG at required sizes and attach to the shared drive. Plan to upload by 11am Thu. :spinner:

elaine (partnerships): Perfect — thanks all. I'll ping GridWave with the checklist and ask them to confirm visual lockup usage. :rocket:
